LessonNote.title: Lesson note
LessonNote.description: A short note on one lesson: the topic, what to bring, homework, or instructions for whoever covers the lesson. Learners see notes for learners in their timetable; a note for the covering teacher reaches staff and the substitute only.

sessionId.description: The learniq lesson this note belongs to. Empty when the lesson comes from the school timetable in planninq.
sessionId.title: Lesson

timetableSessionRef.description: The school timetable lesson this note belongs to, when the timetable comes from planninq: its source system and its reference there.
timetableSessionRef.title: Timetable lesson

sourceSystem.description: The timetabling system the lesson came from.
sourceSystem.title: Source system

externalRef.description: The lesson's reference in that system.
externalRef.title: Reference

cohortId.description: The group of the lesson, copied from the lesson when the note is made.
cohortId.title: Group

topic.description: The topic of the lesson, shown on the lesson in the timetable.
topic.title: Topic

text.description: The note itself: what to bring, homework, or instructions.
text.title: Note

audience.description: Who reads the note. A note for the covering teacher is never shown to learners.
audience.title: Audience

authorId.description: Nextcloud user id of the teacher who wrote the note. The server writes it when the note is made.
authorId.title: Author
